action.message:
Implemented transaction handling for Changelist list_editable processing in django/contrib/admin/options.py.

Change: In ModelAdmin.changelist_view, the loop that saves each changed form (save_form, save_model, save_related, log_change) is now wrapped in `with transaction.atomic(using=router.db_for_write(self.model)):`. This ensures the bulk-edit POST is committed atomically, preventing partial/unexpected database states if an error occurs mid-processing. `transaction` and `router` were already imported.

Verification: scoped_tests public regression selection (admin_changelist) passed — 74 tests, returncode 0.
